reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Loki now enforces a max line size of 256KB by default (you can disable this or increase this but this is how Grafana Labs runs Loki)", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: A max line size of 256KB is now enforced by default; it can be disabled or increased.
consequence.remediation: Review the changes to default configuration values and set the line size limit explicitly if larger lines are needed.

proposed.statement: Loki 3.0.0 now enforces a max log line size of 256KB by default; it can be disabled or raised.
